description: This file defines a Perl package `Git::SVN::GlobSpec` which provides functionality to parse and match filesystem glob patterns, supporting wildcards and patterns within brackets or braces. It includes methods to initialize glob specifications and compute full paths based on these patterns.

classes.name: Git::SVN::GlobSpec
classes.description: A class representing a parsed glob pattern with methods for matching and path expansion.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that parses a glob pattern into internal regex components, supporting wildcards, braces, and segments.

methods.name: full_path
methods.description: Constructs the full filesystem path based on the parsed glob pattern and a relative path.
